title: First Millimeter Detection of the Disk around a Young, Isolated, Planetary-mass Object
question: Can the dust disk around the planetary-mass free-floating object OTS44 be detected at millimeter wavelengths, and does its dust mass follow the M_dust-M_* relation of brown dwarfs and stars?

evidence.loc: 4 Results and discussion: dust disk mass

evidence.loc: 4 Results and discussion: dust disk mass
evidence.quote: we show how our four estimates of the dust mass in the disk around OTS44 compare to literature values for stellar and substellar objects

what.value: Stellar parameters for Cha I comparison sample
